name: host01-pair-host-cli
check: python3 tools/qwen/chk.py server/src/main.rs 'if args.get(1).map(String::as_str) == Some("pair-host") {' 'pairing::new_pair_code(&db, &user_id, &host).await?;' 'println!("{code}");' 'is already paired: unpair it in Machines first' 'if args.get(1).map(String::as_str) == Some("user-adult") {' 'if args.get(1).map(String::as_str) == Some("studio-run") {' || exit 1; cd server && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$HOME/Docker/Personal-projects/kreative-kompanion/server/target timeout 900 nice cargo check -q > /tmp/kk-host01b.txt 2>&1 || { grep -E '^error|^ +--> ' /tmp/kk-host01b.txt | head -20 | sed 's|^|error: server/src/main.rs: |'; exit 1; }

name: host01-install-script
check: test -e tools/install-host.sh || { echo 'error: tools/install-host.sh: not written'; exit 1; }; sh -n tools/install-host.sh 2>&1 | sed 's|^|error: tools/install-host.sh: |' | grep . && exit 1; python3 tools/qwen/chk.py tools/install-host.sh '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' --mode --runner --url --container KOMPANION_CONTAINER:-kreative-kompanion 'docker exec "$C" kompanion-server pair-host' 'curl -fsSL "$URL/install.sh" | sh -s -- "$CODE"' 'Also let Kompanion act on this computer?' || exit 1; sh tools/test_install_host.sh | grep '^error' && exit 1; exit 0
check_errors: error: tools/install-host.sh: tools/install-host.sh: 54: Syntax error: "(" unexpected (expecting "fi")
